name: Improved Galdralag
body:
You are skilled crossing over into other magical fields of study.

Prerequisite(s): Galdralag class feature, Spell Focus

Benefit(s): You learn a single spell of each level of legendary bloodrager spell you can cast from the bard, sorcerer/wizard, or witch spell lists. These must be from a school you have Spell Focus for. When you rest to regain spell slots you can choose to learn a new spell in place of one of these. The new spell’s level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged and must be from a school you have Spell Focus for. When you gain access to a new spell level, you learn a spell of that level in the same manner.
